task: count of primes less than 5 in (list 2 3 5 7 11)
lesson: Today I learned `filter` requires a predicate, not a multiplication function, for selecting primes.

nodes.code: (define (prime? n) (<= 2 n) (or (even? n) (every (lambda (x) (mod n x)) (list 2 3 5 7 11))))~~NL~~(define (count-primes lst) (reduce (lambda (acc x) (+ acc 1)) 0 (filter (lambda (x) (prime? x)) lst)))~~NL~~(rlm-set answer (count-primes (list 2 3 5 7 11)))~~NL~~(final true)
